    One Monte Carlo Replicate for GLM–Based PPI / PPI++ Inference

    ppi_glm_rep_one.Rd

    Performs one Monte Carlo replication of the Prediction-Powered Inference (PPI) or PPI++ estimator for a scalar linear contrast \(\theta = a^\top \beta^\star\) in a generalized linear model (GLM) with canonical link (e.g., logistic regression).

    This function implements:

    • the canonical score formulation \(U(\beta)\) from Section 4,

    • the PPI and PPI++ estimating equations,

    • the contrast-aligned alternative \(\eta_\delta(x) = \eta(x) + \delta (x^\top a)\),

    • cross-fitted prediction models for \(\mu_f(x)\),

    • sandwich variance formulas for GLMs (equations (35)–(38) of the write-up),

    • λ-estimation for PPI++ using plug-in covariance estimators.

    The returned object contains all components needed to compute empirical power, theoretical (closed-form) power, and λ-optimality analyses for GLM PPI/PPI++.

    ppi_glm_rep_one(
  n,
  N,
  X_sampler_L,
  f_generator,
  eps_sampler = NULL,
  model_type = c("glm_correct", "glm_mis", "glm_wrong", "rf", "oracle"),
  a,
  delta = 0,
  ppi_type = c("PPI", "PPI++"),
  theta0 = 0,
  lambda_mode = c("plugin", "oracle"),
  lambda_external = FALSE,
  n_external = ceiling(n/2),
  PPIpp_crossfit = TRUE,
  alpha = 0.05,
  seed = NULL,
  use_true_J = FALSE
)

    Arguments

    n

    Number of labeled observations.

    N

    Number of unlabeled observations.

    X_sampler_L

    Function generating covariate matrices (n x p).

    f_generator

    Function generating the regression signal \(f(X)\).

    eps_sampler

    Noise generator, default NULL. Ignored for Bernoulli outcomes.

    model_type

    Predictive model type ("glm_correct", "glm_mis", "glm_wrong", "rf").

    a

    Contrast vector of length \(p\).

    delta

    Effect size injected via \(f(X) + \delta (X^\top a)\).

    ppi_type

    Either "PPI" (\(\lambda = 1\)) or "PPI++".

    theta0

    Null value of the contrast \(\theta=a^\top\beta^\star\).

    lambda_mode

    For PPI++: "plugin" (estimate \(\lambda\)) or "oracle" (not implemented internally).

    lambda_external

    Logical; if TRUE, estimate \(\lambda\) using an external labeled sample.

    n_external

    Size of the external labeled set if lambda_external = TRUE.

    PPIpp_crossfit

    Logical; if TRUE, use 2-fold cross-fitting for PPI++.

    alpha

    Wald test significance level.

    seed

    Optional random seed.

    Value

    A list with:

    theta_hat

    Estimated contrast \(a^\top \hat\beta\).

    se_hat

    Estimated standard error of \(a^\top \hat\beta\).

    reject

    Logical indicator for Wald test rejection of \(H_0 : \theta = \theta_0\).

    lambda_hat

    Estimated PPI++ shrinkage parameter \(\hat\lambda\).

    beta_hat

    Estimated GLM coefficient vector \(\hat\beta\).

    J_L

    Estimated labeled Fisher information matrix \(J_L = \frac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}^n w(X_i)\,X_i X_i^\top\).

    J_U

    Estimated unlabeled Fisher information matrix \(J_U = \frac{1}{N} \sum_{j=1}^N w(\tilde X_j)\,\tilde X_j \tilde X_j^\top\).

    Sigma_YY_hat

    Sample analogue of the score–residual covariance \(\Sigma_{YY} = \mathrm{Var}\big(X\{Y - \mu_{\beta^\star}(X)\}\big)\).

    Sigma_ff_hat

    Sample analogue of the prediction–error covariance \(\Sigma_{ff} = \mathrm{Var}\big(X\{\mu_f(X) - \mu_{\beta^\star}(X)\}\big)\).

    Sigma_Yf_hat

    Sample analogue of the cross–covariance \(\Sigma_{Yf} = \mathrm{Cov}\big( X\{Y - \mu_{\beta^\star}(X)\},\, X\{\mu_f(X) - \mu_{\beta^\star}(X)\} \big)\).
